public_rationale: CoreWeave completed a $4.2 billion offering in September. Nebius secured a $3.5 billion Citi facility in October. Both occurred after the post and before year-end. Under the stated reading that an executed credit facility counts as financing secured, the forecast was satisfied on October 22. This does not establish that Nebius had received all $3.5 billion in cash.
limitations: The result depends on counting executed borrowing capacity as money raised.
News reports provide the press-basis evidence items; primary issuer records were also read and corroborate the transactions.
No judgment is made about whether the financing was necessary or random.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: CoreWeave and Nebius will raise more billions of dollars in 2026.

statement.excerpt: Nebius had to raise $5 billion, and it’s very obvious that neither of them are done raising billions of dollars at random in 2026.

from_speaker: neither of them are done raising
our_interpretation: Both CoreWeave and Nebius must secure additional financing after publication and by December 31, 2026.
Read “billions” as at least $2 billion for each company, including cumulative qualifying transactions.
Count completed securities offerings and executed lending facilities as financing secured. Do not require every committed loan dollar to have been drawn.
Exclude proposals, customer revenue and previously announced financing completed before publication.
“At random” is rhetorical and supplies no measurable condition.
Use estimate for the press-reported financing basis under the requested classification. This is not a GAAP earnings measure.
criteria.support_condition: Each company secures at least $2 billion of additional external financing during the forecast interval.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After December 31, sufficiently complete financing records show that at least one company secured less than $2 billion during the interval.

evidence.locator: Paragraph following the description of the purchasers' additional $500 million option
evidence.explanation: The full report identifies the completed offering as $4.2 billion of principal, exceeding CoreWeave's threshold. The readable issuer filing independently corroborates the closing.
Reuters identifies the secured Citi facility as $3.5 billion. Nebius's announcement corroborates execution; this clears its threshold when executed borrowing capacity counts as financing raised.

conclusive_event.meets_rule: Nebius's executed facility clears the second company's threshold, following CoreWeave's September closing.
